patchouli.apprenticecodex.apprentices_me: Apprentice's Notes

Apprentice's Codex is an add-on that expands Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.$(br)These handwritten notes were left by the apprentice mage who developed this magic, for other apprentices who would learn it later.
Apprentice's Codex Mod Manual
Devices
Devices that make magic more convenient to use.
Enchantments
Enchantments for magical tools.
Armor and Accessories
Clothing fit for a mage, and accessories to complement it.
Magical Tools
Magical tools for casting spells and supporting your magic.
Staves and Casting Tools
The mage's signature staves, and other tools for spellcasting.
Weapons and Shields
Ways beyond spells to fight those who oppose a mage.

Brews a limited range of potions using %1$s.$(br) It also supplies water to various cauldrons within 2 blocks. A configured $(l:devices/atelier_station)%2$s/$ automatically collects the finished potions.$(br) Like %3$s, it needs no fuel.
Potions are magic too!

A desk for making $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/wooden_wand)wands/$ from a stick, magical ink, and a Focus or scroll of the desired school.$(br) The ink's rarity determines the available spells. The Focus or scroll is not consumed.$(br) $(l:magic_tools/crude_ink)%1$s/$ can also be used, but only for Common spells.
I want to use $(thing)Magic Missile$() right from the start!

Slowly turns $(item)%1$s$() into $(l:magic_tools/crystalline_arcane_shard)%2$s/$.$(br) It takes time, but conversion continues even when you are far away.$(br) Its special process prevents hopper insertion or extraction, making it unsuitable for automation.
This much is probably still allowed...

A desk that stores up to five $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$ or $(l:magic_tools/alchemists_flask)%2$s/$.$(br) It remotely refills the flasks of casters carrying one with the same contents as a stored flask.$(br)
An alchemist of the Overworld's lands.

Place it within 2 blocks of an $(item)%1$s$() and configure extraction to collect its contents automatically.$(br) It can extract up to 64 doses of potion in total, then refill stored flasks or supply casters remotely in the same way.
Likewise, placing $(l:devices/alchemy_brewer)%1$s/$ within 2 blocks and configuring extraction allows automatic collection of the cauldron's contents.
Burns a catalyst with the power of essence to perform special processing.$(br) One catalyst can process up to eight items at once.$(br) Ignite it with $(item)%1$s$() or $(thing)%2$s$().
See the following pages for some representative recipes for this device.
From left to right: $(thing)catalyst$(), $(item)input$(), and $(thing)output$().
Protects nearby items from collection by %1$s when placed.$(br) Experience orbs are not protected. Players standing nearby are unaffected.
Also known as Solegnolia.
Adjusts various magical items and installs scrolls.$(br) Items with a blue frame in their tooltip can be adjusted here.$(br) It can also imbue spells into certain items.
Any scroll can be used, regardless of the spell written on it.

Install a scroll and apply a redstone signal to make it cast a spell.$(br) Supply it with mana potions using $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$ or a similar item.$(br) It cannot cast every spell; see the following pages for details.
It is wooden and can catch fire, but never burns away.

Normally, supplying mana and a redstone signal makes it cast once.$(br) For spells that require continued casting, it keeps casting until the cast time ends, provided the signal remains on.$(br) To cast again, first turn the redstone signal off.

Usable spells are generally limited to:$(br) $(li) Spells that do not require recasting$(li) Spells that target something other than the caster$(li) Spells from Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks or Apprentice's Codex. Some other spells also cannot be used. Insert a scroll to check compatibility.$(br)

Spells from other mods are not supported by default, but support can be added with a data pack.$(br) See the $(l:https://github.com/hexqua/apprentice_codex/wiki/Data%E2%80%90Pack%E2%80%90SpellDispenser%E2%80%90Profiles)GitHub wiki (Japanese only)/$ for details.

Used to craft ammunition for $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)spellguns/$ and $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/throwable_cards)throwing cards/$.$(br) It also adjusts the functions of $(item)certain items$().
Could this pass for Immersive Magic?
Flask Adjustment
Adjusting $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$ lets you control the display of potion effect particles.
Gauntlet Casting Adjustment
Adjust $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/scrollcaster_gauntlet)%1$s/$ to choose which spell it casts when used:$(br2) $(li) The spell selected on the spell wheel$(li) The spell selected by %2$s
Device Upgrades
Combine $(l:magic_tools/luminous_device)%1$s/$ with compatible materials to upgrade the item.
Page Expansion
Combine $(l:equipment_and_accessories/archivists_grimoire)%1$s/$ with compatible materials to increase the number of scrolls the spell book can hold.
Reduces the cooldown of cast spells based on the enchantment level.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/tense)%1$s/$.
Main Enchantable Items
Increases Spell Power for the school of the spell imbued in the enchanted item, based on the enchantment level.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/surge)%1$s/$.
Main Enchantable Items

Exclusive to $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/smashcast_scepter)%1$s/$.$(br) A successful smash attack from a height deals more damage and further increases the imbued spell's Spell Power bonus.$(br) Incompatible with damage enchantments and $(l:enchantments/release)%2$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.
Main Enchantable Items

Applies only to $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$ or $(l:magic_tools/alchemists_flask)%2$s/$.$(br) Increases potion effect levels based on the enchantment level, but reduces their duration.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/red_energy)%3$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.
Applies only to $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$.$(br) Increases potion drinking speed based on the enchantment level.$(br) Available only from an enchanting table.

Applies only to $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$ or $(l:magic_tools/alchemists_flask)%2$s/$.$(br) Increases potion capacity based on the enchantment level.$(br) Available only from an enchanting table.

Exclusive to $(l:equipment_and_accessories/mana_shield_charm)%1$s/$.$(br) The mana barrier can spend a set amount of mana to negate $(thing)%2$s$() and $(l:weapons_and_shields/anti_mana_arrow)%3$s/$.$(br) If mana is insufficient, the effects apply as normal.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/shell)%4$s/$ and $(l:enchantments/synchronization)%5$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.
Like $(thing)%1$s$(), increases mob drop amounts and chances based on the enchantment level.$(br) Works in the off hand, but does not stack with $(thing)%2$s$(); the higher level applies.

Applies only to $(l:magic_tools/spellcasters_flask)%1$s/$ or $(l:magic_tools/alchemists_flask)%2$s/$.$(br) Increases potion effect duration based on the enchantment level.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/glow_energy)%3$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.
Increases Mana Regeneration based on the enchantment level.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/reservoir)%1$s/$.
Main Enchantable Items

Exclusive to $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/smashcast_scepter)%1$s/$.$(br) A successful smash attack from a height launches you upward.$(br) This launch is unaffected by knockback.$(br) Incompatible with damage enchantments and $(l:enchantments/compress)%2$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.
Main Enchantable Items
Increases Max Mana based on the enchantment level.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/reflux)%1$s/$.
Main Enchantable Items

Exclusive to $(l:equipment_and_accessories/mana_shield_charm)%1$s/$.$(br) Greatly reduces the mana barrier's mana cost for negating armor-bypassing damage, but increases its cost for other damage.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/synchronization)%2$s/$ and $(l:enchantments/neutralization)%3$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.
Increases Spell Power for all schools based on the enchantment level.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/attunement)%1$s/$.
Main Enchantable Items

Exclusive to $(l:equipment_and_accessories/mana_shield_charm)%1$s/$.$(br) The mana barrier benefits from the wearer's armor, but activating it damages the armor and costs additional mana.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/shell)%2$s/$ and $(l:enchantments/neutralization)%3$s/$. Available only from an enchanting table.

Applies only to $(l:weapons_and_shields/elemental_bow)%1$s/$ or $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/focus_staffbow)%2$s/$.$(br) Removes the arrow requirement and consumption when casting spells.$(br) Incompatible with $(thing)%3$s$() and $(thing)%4$s$(). Available only from an enchanting table.
Reduces spell cast time based on the enchantment level.$(br) For continuous spells, it extends the time you can keep casting.$(br) Incompatible with $(l:enchantments/alacrity)%1$s/$.
Main Enchantable Items
Raises the level of spells in scroll slots.$(br) This increase can exceed the spell's normal level limit.$(br) This powerful enchantment is not available from an enchanting table.
Main Enchantable Items
Increases experience orb drops from killing mobs or breaking blocks based on the enchantment level.$(br) Works in the off hand, but held items do not stack; the higher level applies.

Boosts Absorption from $(item)%1$s$() and spells like $(thing)%2$s$().$(br) Also restores Absorption up to a cap set by Holy Spell Power.$(br) Absorption negates knockback. Removing this item removes all Absorption.
For Absorption alone, it is like eating Notch apples endlessly.
Apprentice Mage Set
Apprentice Mage's Robes
Magical armor that increases Spell Power.$(br) Its armor value is modest, but it slightly strengthens every spell.
The blue scarf is its trademark.

A spell book that accepts scrolls when held and used, instead of being inscribed at an $(item)%1$s$().$(br) Its initial inventory is limited, but expansion at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%2$s/$ lets it hold far more scrolls than other spell books.
Maybe this one book is all I need.

Not all stored scrolls can be used at once; switch between them while using the book.$(br) Available spells correspond to one inventory row. With the spell wheel open, scroll the mouse wheel to switch rows.
This procedure increases scroll storage.$(br) It does not increase the number of scrolls available at once without switching.
A $(item)%1$s$() adapted into an accessory.$()Its bonuses are smaller and its attack damage penalty is greater, but it can be equipped separately from armor.
To make you a true Lord of Cinder.
A ring that triggers a pre-imbued spell when you attack, like a $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/swingcast_staff)Swingcast Staff/$, though its choice of spells is limited.
It might turn your favorite weapon into a spellsword.
Only spells meeting the following condition can be imbued and used:$(br) $(li) No cast time required

A necklace that casts imbued spells automatically.$(br) Timing is fixed: spells trigger as soon as conditions are met.$(br) For compatible spells, check the tooltip or scroll slots at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.
Probably better than forgetting.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the number of scrolls the amulet can hold.$(br) Multiple scrolls can be installed.
Adjustment: Cast Time Support
Allows scrolls of spells with a cast time.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but the cast time is added to the cooldown.
Adjustment: Wisdom

Makes installed spells take their relevant circumstances into account before triggering.$(br) Few spells are supported; check the tooltip after inserting a scroll.$(br) Data packs can add support for more spells.
Chromatic Magia Dress Set
Chromatic Magia Dress Set

Magical armor that takes on a spell's school as you cast.$(br) Each armor piece has different attunement conditions; check its tooltip.$(br) As advanced magical armor, it allows $(l:equipment_and_accessories/end_game_armors)stat adjustments/$ by placing items in its adjustment slots.
If black cannot be dyed, white can take any color.
Strengthens certain spells, improves mana efficiency, and reduces cooldowns.$(br) Some spells also gain special additional effects.
Let's use Iron's magic like Nouveau!

Spells listed in the tooltip gain:$(br) $(li) Reduced mana cost$(li) Reduced cooldown$(li) No movement speed penalty while casting$(li) Faster block breaking, with main-hand item enchantments applied$(li) More items processed at once by item-processing spells
Drops from felled blocks gather in one place.
Raises the normal iron pickaxe or shovel mining tier to that of a netherite pickaxe or shovel.
Increases the spell's range.
Increases the spell's range.
Works on creatures as well as plants, and also reduces breeding cooldowns.
Increases the spell's range.
Elemental Maiden Set
Elemental Maiden Set

Magical armor granting school Spell Power based on your equipped spell book.$(br) Its imbued $(thing)%1$s$() briefly applies your highest school bonus to all schools.$(br) As advanced armor, it supports $(l:equipment_and_accessories/end_game_armors)stat adjustments/$ with slot items.
Nature's... punishment...
Normally only reduces attack damage. Apply enchantments for magical tools to customize its equipment bonuses.
Surely, you will need a bargain.
Enchantress Set
Enchantress Set

Magical armor that raises enchantment limits while worn.$(br) Grants very little armor, but has magical combat bonuses.$(br) Only the chest piece accepts an imbued spell for extra Spell Power in its school.
Not meant for combat. Probably.
Advanced Armor Adjustments
Advanced Armor Adjustments
Advanced armor made with mithril and similar materials can be further adjusted at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.$(br) Adjustment effects are shared across these armor sets.
Adjustment: Max Mana
Increases Max Mana.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Spell Power
Increases Spell Power for the inserted rune's school.$(br) Only one school rune can be inserted, with no duplicates.
Adjustment: Spell Power
Grants Spell Resistance.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Knockback Resistance
Increases Knockback Resistance.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Weight

Further increases Knockback Resistance, but increases gravity.$(br) Reduces the distance of $(l:enchantments/release)%1$s/$ jumps performed with $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/smashcast_scepter)%2$s/$.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Reduced Gravity
Reduces gravity.$(br) Increases the distance of $(l:enchantments/release)%1$s/$ jumps performed with $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/smashcast_scepter)%2$s/$.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Scroll Slot
Adds a scroll slot to armor other than the chest piece.$(br) Spells in this slot can be used while the armor is worn.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Powder Snow Support
Prevents sinking into powder snow, but does not grant freezing resistance.$(br) Only available for boots. Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Create Goggles
Grants the same effect as wearing Create goggles.$(br) Only available for headgear. Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Magic Proficiency
Adds Magic Proficiency to the armor.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Soul Ward
Adds Soul Ward to the armor and increases its recovery rate.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
A spell book with an inventory unique to each user, like an $(item)%1$s/$.$(br) Spells stored in it are shared across separate $(item)%2$s$() items.
Obtain it by casting this item's $(thing)%1$s$().
An $(item)%1$s$() cannot be inscribed at an $(item)%2$s$().$(br) Instead, hold and use it to open the book directly and install scrolls there.
A spell book preloaded with useful exploration spells.$(br) It has no empty slots by default, and cannot be inscribed at an $(item)%1$s$().
An exploration starter kit.
A spell book preloaded with spells useful at the start of your journey.$(br) Find it in a bonus chest or buy it from an Errand Wizard.
A foot accessory that triggers a pre-imbued spell when you jump in midair. Only certain spells can be imbued.$(br) Its function is suppressed during Creative flight or elytra flight.
Insert $(thing)%1$s$() for a familiar double-jump accessory.
Only spells meeting the following condition can be imbued and used:$(br) $(li) No cast time required
Magi-Agent Set
Magi-Agent Set

Magical armor for certain spells and $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)spellguns/$.$(br) As advanced armor, it supports $(l:equipment_and_accessories/end_game_armors)stat adjustments/$ with slot items. School Spell Power requires adjustment.$(br) Effects vary by piece; check each tooltip.
Don't stand behind me.
A belt that converts mana into compressed air for Create items, storing a small amount.
Let's Create!
A foot accessory for ground mobility.$(br) Spend mana to jump off walls or slide down them.$(br) It can also negate fall damage from high places for a small mana cost.
Hii! Hup! Hah!

An accessory that spends mana to negate incoming damage.$(br) Once mana runs out, it cannot be reused until a certain amount has recovered.$(br) Armor and enchantments cannot reduce the damage handled by the mana barrier.
Apparently, some eccentric wore this and ran through dungeons naked.
Apply special enchantments at an enchanting table to change the mana barrier's properties.$(br) These enchantments are mutually exclusive and cannot be combined.

An accessory that applies $(thing)Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks$() Cast Time Reduction to the charge speed of $(thing)Malum$() staves such as $(item)%1$s$().$(br) Spending mana when using a staff preserves its uses. During cooldown, spending mana immediately restores it.

A foot accessory that spends mana to fly when you jump in midair.$(br) Using it while swimming or flying with elytra spends mana to accelerate.$(br) It does not negate fall damage; use it just before landing to break your fall.
Back when Muramasa was the strongest.

An accessory that shares excess healing from self-healing $(bold)spells$(), such as $(thing)%1$s$(), with nearby summoned mobs.$(br) Healing with $(thing)%2$s$() fully heals every mob in range.$(br) Healing from potions and similar sources is not shared.
Skelly, Zomby, teach them a lesson!
A belt that strengthens certain defensive spells and reduces their mana cost.$(br) Some spells also gain special additional effects.
Barrier! Can't hurt me!
Allows blocking attacks that shields normally cannot block.
Removes the movement speed penalty from a shield raised by the spell, and negates $(thing)%1$s$() from the front.
Increases the damage of the reflected attack released when the spell ends.
Extends the spell's invulnerability and reduces the vulnerable period after it ends.

Shields created while this item is equipped change their behavior.$(br) While their caster wears it, allies, including the caster, can pass through the shield.$(br) The caster's attacks also no longer damage it.
When the spell ends, it releases a shattering ice statue attack like $(thing)%1$s$(), at the same level as the cast $(thing)%2$s$().
Doubles the number of dodges granted when the spell is cast.
While the spell is active and this item is equipped, accumulated damage is reduced from the normal 50% to 25%.

An accessory for casting spells installed at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.$(br) Use the spell wheel as usual, or assign a dedicated key in Controls to cast its spell anytime.$(br) Only one can be equipped at once.
If you can't trust me, you were a fool to come here.
Casting During Cooldown

Spend a special charge to cast once while ignoring a spell's cooldown.$(br) Charge recovery time depends on the cast spell's cooldown.$(br) Trying to cast with no charge forces a reload. You cannot move while reloading, and taking damage cancels it.
Adjustment: Scroll Slot
Increases this item's scroll capacity.$(br) Only one spell is usable at once. If several are installed, hold the item and sneak to switch.
Install a scroll beforehand at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$ to trigger that spell in addition to spells you cast.
The follow-up magic made the damage climb even faster.

Only spells meeting these conditions can be imbued and used:$(br) $(li) No cast time$(li) No recasting$(li) From Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks or Apprentice's Codex$(li) Configured beforehand by a data pack or similar. Some spells still cannot be used; insert a scroll to check.$(br) Data packs can add support for more spells.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the number of scrolls the amulet can hold.$(br) Multiple scrolls can be installed.
Adjustment: Cast and Channel Support
Allows scrolls of spells that require a cast time or continuous casting.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but cast time is added to the cooldown.$(br) Continuous spells last at most 5 seconds.
Converts the wearer's health into mana when mana is low.$(br) Does not work at low health. Spending too much mana at once increases recovery speed, but also increases health consumption.
An offering to yourself, not an altar.

A cloak accessory that also serves as an $(item)%1$s/$.$(br) It supports both flight and magical hovering.$(br) These use cloak energy rather than mana or durability. When its functions are idle, it draws the wearer's mana to replenish its energy.
Is there an answer beyond this battle?
When used as an $(item)%1$s/$, it cannot be combined with an equipped $(item)%2$s/$ or flight spells such as $(thing)%3$s/$.$(br) Otherwise, fly just as you would with an $(item)%4$s/$.

Equipping the cloak unlocks this spell, which toggles hovering using cloak energy.$(br) While hovering, use $(thing)$(k:jump)/$ to spend energy on a fast dash in any direction.$(br) Stay still to maintain a slightly higher position and prepare for attacks from below.
Adjustment: Scroll Slot
Adds scroll slots to the cloak.$(br) Spells in these slots can be used at any time while it is worn.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Spell Power
Grants Spell Resistance.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Cloak Energy Capacity
Increases maximum cloak energy.$(br) Does not affect recovery or consumption rates.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Adjustment: Cloak Energy Recovery
Increases cloak energy recovery speed without increasing mana cost, restoring more energy with less mana.$(br) Only one can be inserted at a time.
Behavior: Burning Dash

Incompatible with other $(thing)behavior adjustments/$.$(br) Elytra takeoff or $(thing)$(k:jump:)/$ in flight triggers $(thing)%1$s/$, also replacing the $(thing)%2$s/$ hover dash.$(br) $(thing)%3$s/$ matches your inscribed spell, or is level 1 if absent.
Behavior: Momentum
A $(thing)behavior adjustment/$; incompatible with others of this type.$(br) Preserves momentum after the hover dash from $(thing)%1$s/$ instead of stopping.
Behavior: Firework Rockets

A $(thing)behavior adjustment/$; incompatible with others.$(br) Starting elytra flight or using $(thing)$(k:jump:)/$ in flight consumes non-explosive $(item)%1$s/$ from your inventory.$(br) Also uses $(item)%2$s/$ in $(thing)%3$s/$ or an $(item)%4$s/$.
Behavior: Volt Strike

A $(thing)behavior adjustment/$; incompatible with others of this type.$(br) Replaces the hover dash from $(thing)%1$s/$ with $(thing)%2$s/$.$(br) Uses the same $(thing)%3$s/$ as inscribed in your spell book or similar; defaults to level 1 if absent.
Behavior: Quick Blink
A $(thing)behavior adjustment/$; incompatible with others of this type.$(br) Replaces the hover dash from $(thing)%1$s/$ with $(thing)%2$s/$.$(br) You are completely invulnerable during the blink.
Soulcollector Set
Soulcollector Set
Magical armor that grants the same equipment effects as $(thing)Malum$() Soulhunter armor, while also increasing Max Mana.
You belong to me!!

A ring that parries and negates frontal attacks immediately after you begin casting.$(br) Does not trigger for instant or continuous spells, or attacks from other directions.$(br) There is no effect cooldown as long as you have just begun casting.
An endless adventure, once again.
Also works when charging $(thing)Malum$() staves such as $(item)%1$s$().

A portable inventory for $(thing)Curios$() accessories.$(br) Right-click it directly in the inventory screen to open it and equip or remove accessories.$(br) Sneak while using it to place it as a block.
I'd like to think it beats the one from flower magic.

An accessory that stores ammunition for $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)spellguns/$ and supplies it directly.$(br) Equipping it greatly increases the chance of recovering empty casings.$(br) Ammunition can also be used with it merely in your inventory.
Somewhere, there are mages who use runes as ammunition.

Stores various arrows for compatible bows.$(br) Fits several slots, but only one can be worn at once. While worn, drawing a bow does not slow you.$(br) Arrows can also be used with it unequipped in your inventory.
Mages use bows too, sometimes.
A spell book whose stats improve with scrolls inscribed at an $(item)%1$s$().$(br) It grants no bonuses initially, but has great potential.
Chasing otherwise rare bonuses is part of the fun.

Inscribed scrolls change its stats as follows:$(br2) $(li) Rarity increases Max Mana and Spell Power$(li) Rarity increases Spell Power for the inscribed school$(li) Many different schools reduce cooldowns$(li) Many spells of one school reduce cast time
Stealth Rune Set
Stealth Rune Set

Magical armor that does not disrupt ordinary Invisibility, even without the $(thing)%1$s$() spell.$(br) Its runes merely avoid disrupting the effect; the armor can still be seen with the naked eye.$(br) Unlike other armor, it accepts some magical tool enchantments.
Haidara!

An accessory with reusable $(item)%1$s$() power.$(br) Activating it starts a long cooldown. Cast the $(thing)%2$s$() granted during cooldown to greatly shorten it.$(br) Cooldown is per user; extra copies do not help.
A gift from an evil villager.

A flask that turns its contents into splash potions.$(br) Rather than throwing the flask, cast $(thing)%1$s$() to extract its contents.$(br) Regular potions can also be used, but potion solution efficiency is lower.
Barrel!
Special fuel infused with the essence of a $(item)%1$s/$.$(br) When burned in an $(item)%2$s, %3$s, or %4$s/$, it speeds up smelting.
Its drawback is poor mass-production potential.
Magical Materials
Some special materials are needed to craft magical tools.$(br) Most can be processed from other materials, without mining or discovering new resources while exploring.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is made by processing $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) It is a basic material for magical tools and is also used in ammunition for advanced $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)spellguns/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is made by processing $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) It is used to craft magical tools and as a catalyst for $(thing)certain spells/$.
Any kind of $(item)scroll/$ can be used.
An $(item)%1$s/$ is made by processing $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) Used to craft certain advanced tools.
An $(item)%1$s/$ drops from $(thing)%2$s/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is made by processing $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) Needed to craft the $(l:equipment_and_accessories/magi_agent_suit_set)Magi-Agent Set/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is made by processing $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) Needed to craft the $(l:equipment_and_accessories/element_maiden_set)Elemental Maiden Set/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ can be obtained from a $(thing)Vault/$.$(br) Used to craft $(item)%2$s/$, which is useful for many adjustments.
Defeating an ominous boss regenerates the $(thing)Vault/$, providing a reliable source of $(item)%1$s/$.

A magical plant that does not grow naturally.$(br) Harvest plants generated by $(thing)%1$s/$, or obtain it from an $(thing)Errand Wizard's House/$.$(br) Used for potions of $(thing)%2$s/$. Eating it grants the same effect briefly.
Combine it with $(item)%1$s/$ for an efficient food source.

A material for making $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/wooden_wand)wands/$ at $(l:devices/apprentice_desk)%1$s/$.$(br) Only makes Common spells and is single-use, but uses materials familiar to any crafter.
Even the ordinary Overworld is full of magic.

A crystallized form of $(item)%1$s/$.$(br) Obtain it using $(l:devices/arcanum_in_a_jar)%2$s/$ or by killing mobs with $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/swingcast_staff)%3$s/$.$(br) Smelt it into $(item)%4$s/$, or use it as an intermediate material for various items.
Note that it can only be smelted in an $(item)%1$s/$.

One of the $(l:magic_tools/spell_amplifier_series)spell amplifiers/$.$(br) In the off hand, it lets you step up 1-block ledges and slightly increases movement speed.$(br) Its exclusive spell, $(thing)%1$s/$, allows walking on water and stepping up 2-block ledges while active.
In the end, your own feet are the most reliable.

A rideable broom for slow, free flight using mana.$(br) Mounting needs a minimum mana reserve. When mana runs out, it falls rapidly.$(br) The broom has durability; breaking it ends flight.$(br) Adjust it at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.
A broom that cannot fly is just a broom.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Adds spell slots usable only while riding the broom.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Back-Mounted Broom

Allows equipping the broom as a back accessory.$(br) The granted $(thing)%1$s/$ lets you mount instantly.$(br) This summoned broom is not the item itself, so it stays equipped. After dismounting and moving a little away, it is automatically stowed.
Adjustment: Fire Resistance
Grants the broom Fire Resistance.$(br) Does not protect the rider, who needs separate resistance.
Adjustment: Overdrive
Increases broom speed, but greatly increases mana consumption.
Adjustment: Underwater Mobility
Brooms normally lose much of their mobility underwater. This adjustment restores normal movement.$(br) Also lets the broom ignore underwater currents.

A tool that magically creates $(l:equipment_and_accessories/ender_grimoire)%1$s/$.$(br) It serves only to obtain $(l:equipment_and_accessories/ender_grimoire)%2$s/$, but lets you quickly replace a lost $(l:equipment_and_accessories/ender_grimoire)%3$s/$.
As many as you need, when you need them.

A rideable broom that spends mana to skim just above the ground.$(br) Hold $(thing)$(k:jump)/$ to coast on momentum, saving mana.$(br) It has durability; if it breaks, it can no longer stay aloft.$(br) Adjust its stats at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.
Have you no heart, boss?!
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Adds spell slots usable only while riding the broom.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Back-Mounted Broom

Allows equipping the broom as a back accessory.$(br) The granted $(thing)%1$s/$ lets you mount instantly.$(br) This summoned broom is not the item itself, so it stays equipped. After dismounting and moving a little away, it is automatically stowed.
Adjustment: Fire Resistance
Grants the broom Fire Resistance.$(br) Does not protect the rider, who needs separate resistance.
Adjustment: Overdrive
Increases broom speed, but greatly increases mana consumption.$(br) Also increases speed when ending momentum coasting, with a much higher mana cost then as well.
Adjustment: Charge Attack
Above a certain speed, the broom deals magic damage to mobs it touches, based on speed.$(br) Damage scales with the $(thing)Lightning school/$.
A single-use tool that casts a weaker $(thing)%1$s/$.$(br) $(thing)%2$s/$ consumes an offering of a school-related item to point toward a nearby structure associated with that school.
Try to obtain the spell version as soon as possible.

Stores many light-source items, such as $(item)%1$s$(), and places them directly when used.$(br) Right-click compatible items into it in the inventory. Picking up items matching its stored contents automatically stores them.

Hold it and sneak to switch placement items or modes.$(br) It has a dedicated $(thing)mana tank/$; the upgrade spells described later draw from this tank, not the user.$(br) Right-click $(item)mana potions/$ onto the item to refill the $(thing)mana tank/$.
See? Much brighter now.
Install $(thing)%1$s$() to add its function.$(br) Spend extra mana to attempt placement beyond its normal range.
Install $(thing)%1$s$() to add its function.$(br) Also greatly increases the $(thing)mana tank/$ capacity of $(item)%2$s/$ itself.
Install $(thing)%1$s$() to remove lights placed by $(thing)%2$s/$ or $(thing)%3$s/$.$(br) Removed lights are converted back into mana in its tank.
One of the $(l:magic_tools/spell_amplifier_series)spell amplifiers/$.$(br) Holding it in the off hand greatly increases Mana Regeneration.
In a certain universe, it was the battery everyone dreamed of.
Spell Amplifiers
Spell Amplifiers

Tools that boost various stats in the off hand.$(br) Primarily intended to replace awkward shields when using staves with their own use action.$(br) If the main-hand item has no use action, using this item casts your selected spell.

An amplifier's material determines its bonuses.$(br) It can be imbued with a spell, which can be extracted at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.$(br) It also accepts magical stat enchantments. All stat bonuses, including enchantments, apply only in the off hand.
An $(item)%1$s/$ slightly increases Spell Power for all schools.
It's Iron's magic, so iron is the foundation.
A $(item)%1$s/$ increases Spell Power for its imbued spell's school.$(br) It comes with $(thing)%2$s/$ already imbued.
It conducts magic just like electricity.
A $(item)%1$s/$ improves casting efficiency.$(br) It grants $(thing)shorter cast times / longer continuous casting/$ and $(thing)shorter spell cooldowns/$.
Magic means gold.
A $(item)%1$s/$ increases movement speed while casting.$(br) Has no particular effect on spells without a cast time.
Perfect for a battle mage.
A $(item)%1$s/$ grants the diamond version's effects, plus Armor and Armor Toughness while in the off hand.
If you can't raise a shield, just get tougher.
A $(item)%1$s/$ greatly increases Max Mana.$(br) It is also one of the items supported by $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%2$s/$.
Silver added by industrial mods cannot be used to craft it.
A $(item)%1$s/$ grants $(thing)increased Malum magic damage/$ and a small amount of $(thing)Soul Ward/$.$(br)
Magic Proficiency seems useful for unusual spells such as $(thing)%1$s/$. There may be others, too.

Extracts scrolls from your own imbued items or certain pre-imbued weapons found in dungeons.$(br) Process it with the target item at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%1$s/$ to extract the scroll, $(bold)destroying the item/$.$(br) Only some dungeon weapons are supported.
This should ease the disappointment.
The item is lost permanently, so do not use this on anything important.$(br) Spells already built into crafted items cannot be extracted.

A flask that combines potions with the same effect.$(br) Splash potions can be stored and drunk, but potion solution efficiency is lower.$(br) Adjust it at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%1$s/$ to toggle potion effect particles.
Just being stackable makes all the difference.
A magical tool pre-imbued with $(thing)%1$s/$, $(thing)%2$s/$, and $(thing)%3$s/$.$(br) Sneak to switch spells.$(br) Right-click it in the inventory screen to activate $(thing)%4$s/$ directly.
Backpacks tend to steal its spotlight.

A casting tool that adds a cast time to instant spells to increase Spell Power.$(br) Install an instant spell's scroll at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$, then use the item to cast it.$(br) Its spells also appear on the spell wheel; select them there for normal instant use.
Fairy not included.
Adjustment: School Specialization
Increases Spell Power for the inserted rune's school, but reduces general Spell Power.$(br) Only one school rune can be inserted, with no duplicates.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the book's scroll capacity.$(br) With multiple scrolls, hold the book and sneak to select its spell.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Power Conversion
Cast Time Reduction normally shortens the book's cast time. This adjustment instead converts that time reduction into additional Spell Power.
Adjustment: Off-Hand Use
Moves the book's main-hand magical stat bonuses to the off hand.$(br) After this adjustment, holding it in the main hand grants no bonuses.
Adjustment: Wisdom
Allows casting your selected spell through the book, as well as its installed spells.$(br) The selected spell must also be an instant spell.

A staff that can be charged and thrown like an $(item)%1$s/$.$(br) Throwing creates a magical copy, costing mana but keeping the original in your hand.$(br) Enchant with $(thing)%2$s/$ to reduce the throwing mana cost.
Crafter, become a legend.

Enchant with $(thing)%1$s/$ to spend mana on $(thing)%2$s/$ regardless of weather.$(br) Keep activating it while active to sustain $(thing)%3$s/$ as long as mana lasts.$(br) Incompatible with $(thing)%4$s/$ and $(thing)%5$s/$.

Enchant with $(thing)%1$s/$ to remotely cast your selected spell at the thrown staff's tip.$(br) Only spells predefined in data are supported.$(br) The normal lightning from $(thing)%2$s/$ does not occur. Incompatible with $(thing)%3$s/$.
A staff that forces a spell to cast despite its cooldown when used in the main hand.$(br) Select a spell on cooldown and cast through the staff.

Ignoring cooldown greatly increases mana cost. Spending more mana than you have overheats the staff, disabling it temporarily.$(br) Extra cost depends on the cooldown ignored and consecutive bypasses.$(br) Immerse an overheated staff in water to cool it faster.
Water-cooled. (Really!)

A combat staff with a crystal blade for melee combat.$(br) Hits create automatically collected mana-restoring orbs.$(br) Swinging without hitting casts $(thing)%1$s/$; its slashes also create mana orbs on hit.
Maybe it is more sword than staff.

Draw this staff like a bow in your main hand to boost spells.$(br) Charge up to a power limit at a much higher mana cost.$(br) You can cast with too little mana, but the staff then drains mana and cannot cast until the deficit is repaid.
Pierce through!
Casting with this staff normally requires arrows. $(thing)%1$s/$ removes their consumption.

A spellgun with a special mechanism for rapid repeated casting.$(br) Unlike other $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)spellguns/$ and $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/multipurpose_staffrifle)%1$s/$, it consumes mana and recoils when casting. Its required $(item)%2$s/$ also uses very expensive mithril.
Heavy machine gun!
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the spellgun's scroll capacity.$(br) With multiple scrolls, hold it and sneak to select its spell.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Cast Time Support
Allows scrolls of spells with a cast time.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but the cast time is added to the cooldown.
Adjustment: Recoil Suppression
Completely negates recoil from casting.
Adjustment: Echo Casting

Spells trigger as though echoed by $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/multicast_echo_staff)%1$s/$.$(br) Supported spells can attack through the target's invulnerability frames, often with reduced power. Mana cost doubles regardless of support.

A $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/swingcast_staff)Swingcast Staff/$ that casts your selected spell on hit instead of an imbued spell.$(br) Normally supports only instant spells, but certain adjustments at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$ enable cast-time spells.$(br) The staff itself cannot be imbued.
Which one shall I choose?
A casting staff with the power of an $(item)%1$s/$.$(br) Cast its imbued $(thing)%2$s/$ to build echoes, then cast a supported spell from $(bold)this staff/$ to repeat it for each echo.
Accel, accel, accel!

A versatile rifle-shaped $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)spellgun/$.$(br) Install multiple spells at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$. Like other spellguns, it uses special ammunition instead of mana.$(br) Hold it and sneak to switch installed spells.
Easy as pie.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the spellgun's scroll capacity.$(br) Multiple items can be inserted.
Adjustment: Cast Time Support
Allows scrolls of spells with a cast time.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but the cast time is added to the cooldown.
Adjustment: Recoil Suppression
Completely negates recoil from casting.
Adjustment: Wisdom
Targets the spell selected on the spell wheel instead of an installed spell.$(br) In exchange, spells can no longer be installed in the spellgun's scroll slots.
Adjustment: Scope
Uses a spyglass to zoom when aiming the spellgun.

A casting staff that switches affinities between schools.$(br) Cast its imbued $(thing)%1$s/$, then another spell from $(bold)this staff/$ to analyze it and switch the staff's school Spell Power to that spell's school.
This world is your canvas.

Install spells at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$ in this $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/swingcast_staff)Swingcast Staff/$. Each swingcast cycles to the next spell.$(br) Normally limited to instant spells; specific adjustments at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%2$s/$ enable cast-time spells.
You've got good taste.
Adjustment: School Specialization
Increases Spell Power for the inserted rune's school, but reduces general Spell Power.$(br) Only one school rune can be inserted, with no duplicates.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the staff's scroll capacity.
Adjustment: Cast Time Support
Allows scrolls of spells with a cast time.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but the cast time is added to the cooldown.
Adjustment: Automatic Skip
Advances to the next spell slot even when a staff swing fails to cast.

A casting tool that holds several scrolls, letting you switch spells to suit the situation.$(br) Install them at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$, sneak to select one, and cast much as you would with an imbued weapon.
Some ancient mages used gauntlets rather than staves, apparently.
Adjustment: School Specialization
Increases Spell Power for the inserted rune's school, but reduces general Spell Power.$(br) Only one school rune can be inserted, with no duplicates.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the gauntlet's scroll capacity.
Adjustment: Swingcasting
Attacking with the gauntlet automatically casts your selected spell.$(br) Cast-time spells trigger instantly, but their cooldown is extended by the cast time.$(br) Continuous spells cannot be used.

A staff that strengthens and triggers its imbued spell with a smash attack from a height.$(br) Requires roughly 2 blocks of height or more.$(br) A successful smash also increases the staff's attack damage and negates fall damage.
Goshikaaan!

Unlike normal $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/swingcast_staff)Swingcast Staves/$, this one bears the principles of another magic.$(br) Swing it as usual to fire three $(thing)Mnemonic Blades/$.$(br) Their power is said to scale with Magic Proficiency...
Crafting Method
Process an $(item)%1$s/$ using $(thing)Malum/$'s $(item)%2$s/$ to make this staff.$(br) Check a recipe viewer such as JEI for the process.
Spellgun Ammunition
Spellgun Ammunition

$(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_system)Spellguns/$ cast using special cartridges instead of the user's mana.$(br) The required cartridge depends on the gun and its imbued spell. Prepare the appropriate ammunition.$(br) Craft cartridges at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%1$s/$.

Used cartridges sometimes return an $(item)empty casing/$; $(l:equipment_and_accessories/spellcaster_ammo_pouch)%1$s/$ greatly increases this chance.$(br) Cartridges stored in $(l:equipment_and_accessories/spellcaster_ammo_pouch)%2$s/$ are used automatically even if the pouch is not equipped.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is the cheapest cartridge, exclusive to $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) Unlike other ammunition, it can also be crafted with an $(item)%3$s/$, but less efficiently than at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%4$s/$.
A stopgap until you make $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%1$s/$.$(br) There is no recipe using empty casings, however.
Craftable with the cheapest $(item)%1$s/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is an inexpensive cartridge exclusive to $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) It supports only low-rarity spells.
Craftable with $(item)%1$s/$, which is relatively easy to mass-produce.
An $(item)%1$s/$ is a cartridge exclusive to $(item)%2$s/$.$(br) Required for high-rarity spells.
Hard to mass-produce until you have a steady supply of $(item)%1$s/$.
An $(item)%1$s/$ is a low-rarity cartridge for spellguns that support cast-time spells.
Craftable with $(item)%1$s/$, which can be obtained in reasonable quantities.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is the highest-tier cartridge for spellguns that support cast-time spells.
Its $(item)%1$s/$ needs a $(item)scroll/$. Reclaim casings with $(l:equipment_and_accessories/spellcaster_ammo_pouch)%2$s/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is exclusive to $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/multipurpose_staffrifle)%2$s/$.$(br) Required regardless of the spell's type or rarity.
Obtain the $(item)%1$s/$ used to make $(item)%2$s/$ from $(thing)%3$s/$ for a convenient supply.
A $(item)%1$s/$ is exclusive to $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/fullauto_rapidcast_spellrifle)%2$s/$.$(br) This spellgun alone also requires mana.
Very expensive because it requires $(item)%1$s/$.
Spellguns
Spellguns

Gun-shaped casting tools that use $(l:staves_and_casting_devices/spellgun_ammo)special cartridges/$ instead of mana to cast pre-imbued compatible spells.$(br) In the main hand, attacking fires the spellgun instead of making a melee attack, keeping off-hand tools easy to use.

Materials give these guns very different uses; research before crafting to choose one that suits your goal.$(br) Magical enchantment bonuses apply only in the main hand.$(br) Cartridges only replace mana consumption. You still cannot cast a spell beyond your Max Mana capacity.

An $(item)%1$s/$ specializes in lightweight spells such as $(thing)%2$s/$.$(br) Greatly reduces cooldown, but supports only instant spells with short base cooldowns and no recasting.$(br) Comes imbued with $(thing)%3$s Lv. 1/$.
A magical energy blaster, then.
A $(item)%1$s/$ supports spells with a cast time.$(br) Cooldown is slightly longer than the iron version, but cast-time spells become relatively easy to use.
There are other ways to skip casting, but this is probably the easiest.

Like the iron version, a $(item)%1$s/$ supports only instant spells.$(br) It has no base cooldown length or recast restrictions and reduces cooldown.$(br) A minimum cooldown remains; it cannot remove cooldown entirely.
It would be nice to use a slightly heavy spell as a normal attack.
A $(item)%1$s/$ supports all spells except those requiring continuous casting.$(br) Unlike other materials, it does not reduce cooldown, but has the fewest spell restrictions.
Don't call it indiscriminate.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is usable even when special armor removes your spellcasting ability.$(br) It has no Max Mana casting limit and is unaffected by the wearer's Spell Power.$(br) Check a recipe viewer such as JEI for its processing recipe.
Adjustment: Off-Hand Use
Moves the spellgun's main-hand magical stat bonuses to the off hand.$(br) After this adjustment, holding it in the main hand grants no bonuses.
Swingcast Staves
Swingcast Staves

Staves that cast an imbued spell when swung like a sword.$(br) Using them normally casts your selected spell, like other staves.$(br) With a shield or similar item in the off hand, you can use that item instead of casting.

Material greatly changes a Swingcast Staff's extra effects.$(br) Imbued spells can be extracted at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$.$(br) Magical stat enchantments are also supported, but all bonuses, including enchantments, apply only in the main hand.

An $(item)%1$s/$ is the lowest-tier Swingcast Staff, with iron sword attack damage.$(br) Supports only instant spells without recasting.$(br) Killing mobs with it may drop $(l:magic_tools/crystalline_arcane_shard)%2$s/$.
Crafting this first makes progression in Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks easier.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is a low-tier Swingcast Staff with modest attack damage.$(br) Supports only instant spells without recasting.$(br) Grants Spell Power for its imbued school and comes with $(thing)%2$s Lv. 1/$.
Which is better for magic: copper or gold?
A $(item)%1$s/$ has gold sword attack damage.$(br) Supports only instant spells.$(br) Attacks faster than other staves. As a staff, it avoids gold's usual low durability problem.
Firing spells instead of normal attacks feels rather mage-like.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is an advanced Swingcast Staff with diamond sword attack damage.$(br) Supports only instant spells.$(br) Landing a normal staff attack advances the imbued spell's cooldown by a set amount.
Diamond's own high stats make it ideal for fast close combat.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is top-tier, with netherite sword damage.$(br) Only accepts instant spells.$(br) Normal hits reduce its spell's cooldown. Main-hand use prevents cast interruption, like an $(item)%2$s/$.
A staff for committed close combat that saves a precious accessory slot.

A $(item)%1$s/$ is an advanced Swingcast Staff with modest attack damage.$(br) Supports both instant and cast-time spells. Cast-time spells trigger immediately without casting.$(br) Their cooldown is extended by the original cast time.
What? I only skipped the incantation.
Spell Throwing Cards
Spell Throwing Cards

Consumables made by copying spells onto special cards.$(br) Only data-supported spells are usable. Throwing a card triggers a spell according to the card type.$(br) Both types are crafted at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%1$s/$.
A $(item)%1$s/$ casts at the impact point; an $(item)%2$s/$ stops in the air and casts there.$(br) Both consume mana when their spell triggers.
A $(item)%1$s/$ casts at its impact point.$(br) Like arrows and snowballs, its flight is affected by gravity and liquid resistance.$(br) Crafting does not consume the $(item)scroll/$.
An unused card can be reused.$(br) The scroll is not consumed either.
An $(item)%1$s/$ stops in the air shortly after being thrown, then casts after a delay.$(br) Crafting does not consume the $(item)scroll/$.
Unused cards of this type can also be reused.$(br) The scroll is likewise not consumed.
Wands
A disposable wand crafted at $(l:devices/apprentice_desk)%1$s/$.$(br) Its durability is only that of a wooden tool and it consumes mana, but it is relatively cheap to make.
A casting staff built to support every school.$(br) When casting a spell outside your strongest school, it applies your highest school bonus $(bold)at an enormous mana cost/$.
In another world, even after reaching the zenith, the "final" kept happening again.

An arrow crafted at $(l:devices/spellcaster_workbench)%1$s/$, useful in special situations.$(br) Hitting a $(thing)mob summoned by a spell/$ immediately dismisses it. Hitting a $(thing)player/$ wearing $(l:equipment_and_accessories/mana_shield_charm)%2$s/$ disables their mana barrier for a while.
Remember, it is not quite a substitute for Counterspell.
A shield that continuously casts its imbued spell while raised.$(br) Blocks attacks normal shields cannot, such as axes and sonic booms, and negates some knockback that occurs even when blocking.
When in doubt, use a greatshield. Remember that.
Adjustment: School Resistance
Grants Spell Resistance for the inserted rune's school.$(br) As slots allow, you may insert duplicate runes or runes of different schools.
Adjustment: Wisdom
Allows casting your selected spell through the shield, as well as its installed spells.$(br) The selected spell must support continuous casting.

Install arrow spell scrolls in this bow at $(l:devices/spell_calibration_bench)%1$s/$. Hold it and sneak to switch modes.$(br) Rapid fire bypasses cooldown separately from normal casting; each bypass raises mana cost.$(br) It can also switch between various arrows.
Just a bow, yet so much more.

The bow's cooldown is separate from normal casting, but shared per player. Changing bows or spells cannot bypass it.$(br) Cast-time spells begin casting and targeting when you draw. Hold after preparation, then release to fire. Early release, switching items, or opening a screen cancels without consumption.$(br)
Casting through the bow is not treated as normal spellcasting. Taking damage does not cancel drawing, but Cast Time Reduction does not apply.
Casting with this staff normally requires arrows. $(thing)%1$s/$ removes their consumption.$(br) It is incompatible with $(thing)%2$s/$, so not every arrow cost can be removed.
Adjustment: Slot Expansion
Increases the bow's scroll capacity.
Adjustment: Forced School

Bow-cast spells use the inserted rune's school bonus.$(br) The spell's actual school is unchanged. Mana cost doubles regardless of its original school.$(br) Only one school rune can be inserted, with no duplicates.
Adjustment: Separate Overheating
Separates bow overheating by spell slot.$(br) Overheating remains tied to the user, so multiple copies of the same bow still share it.

A blade that blocks while raised, consuming mana.$(br) Raise it with good timing to parry, improving defense without mana cost.$(br) It can be imbued; your bonus for the imbued spell's school raises both attack damage and attack mana cost.
Samurai can use magic. Everyone knows that.

A buckler that raises instantly. Block just after raising it to cast its imbued spell without mana cost.$(br) Raising it does not slow you. Blocking later or taking damage while raised lowers it and prevents raising it again for a while.
Do you prefer parrying?$(br) Or perfect guarding?

If the trigger conditions are met while the imbued spell is on cooldown, reduces its cooldown by a fixed proportion instead.$(br) With the $(thing)Wisdom/$ adjustment, it can reduce all the user's spell cooldowns.
Adjustment: Cast Time Support
Allows scrolls of spells with a cast time.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but the cast time is added to the cooldown.
Adjustment: Wisdom
Allows casting your selected spell through the shield, as well as its installed spells.$(br) The selected spell must also be usable with this shield.
A shield that casts its imbued spell when it blocks an attack while raised.$(br) Otherwise, it performs much like a normal shield.
Sword not included.
Adjustment: Cast and Channel Support
Allows scrolls of cast-time and continuous spells.$(br) No actual casting is performed, but cast time is added to the cooldown.
Adjustment: Wisdom
Allows casting your selected spell through the shield, as well as its installed spells.$(br) The selected spell must also be usable with this shield.
A scythe with somewhat high attack damage but slow attack speed.$(br) Charge and use it to throw it at a mana cost. Continue spending mana to keep it in place, attacking repeatedly.
A shape fit for reaping magic.
A dagger that grants the off-hand bonuses of a staff normally effective only in the main hand.$(br) Cast its exclusive $(thing)%1$s$() to copy the dagger and dual-wield it for rapid melee combat.
A mage's last resort is a dagger.

A greatsword with long reach and strong sweeping attacks.$(br) Casting while holding it stores magic residue based on spell cooldown, shifting its stats toward $(bold)heavy swings/$.$(br) With enough residue, charge and use it to temporarily favor light, wide sweeps.
It was far too large to be called a sword.
